name: flexui-monorepo
description: FlexUI 2.0 monorepo: Go compiler, TypeScript npm CLI and examples

scripts.build:integrations: tsc -p packages/vite-plugin/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/vue/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/svelte/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/runtime/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vite-plugin/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/vue/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/svelte/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/components/tsconfig.json --noEmit
